description: This file defines an interface for a module named ILISA in the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares a variety of abstract classes and structs that encapsulate operations related to application management, storage, metadata, notifications, and locking mechanisms, primarily for application lifecycle and resource handling in a device or platform environment.

classes.name: ILISA
classes.description: An interface representing various application lifecycle and resource management operations, including install, uninstall, download, reset, metadata management, notifications, and locking mechanisms.

classes.name: IStorage
classes.description: Provides methods for retrieving storage location, quota, and usage information.

classes.name: IStoragePayload
classes.description: Provides access to stored application and persistent data storage objects.

classes.name: IKeyValue
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair, used for metadata or resource identification.

classes.name: IMetadataPayload
classes.description: Provides application metadata including app name, category, URL, resources, and auxiliary metadata.

classes.name: IAppVersion
classes.description: Represents application version information with an iterator to traverse multiple versions.

classes.name: IApp
classes.description: Represents an application with its type, id, and versions, and an iterator to traverse multiple applications.

classes.name: IHandleResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an application lock operation, providing a handle.

classes.name: ILockInfo
classes.description: Details about an application lock, including reason and owner.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about operation statuses.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Downloads and installs an application bundle given its type, id, version, URL, name, and category; outputs a handle.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls an application by type, id, version, and uninstall type; outputs a handle.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads an application's resource file given its type, id, version, resource key, URL; outputs a handle.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Deletes local persistent data for an application given its type, id, version, and reset type.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage usage details for an application.

methods.name: SetAuxMetadata
methods.description: Sets auxiliary metadata for an application.

methods.name: ClearAuxMetadata
methods.description: Clears auxiliary metadata for an application.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Fetches application metadata.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing asynchronous request identified by handle.

methods.name: GetProgress
methods.description: Retrieves progress percentage of an ongoing request.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers for notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters from notifications.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ILISA module with a JSON or string configuration.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Gets the application version.

methods.name: AppName
methods.description: Gets the application name.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Gets the application category.

methods.name: Url
methods.description: Gets the application's URL.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Gets the application type.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Gets the application identifier.

methods.name: Installed
methods.description: Gets an iterator to traverse different versions of the application.

methods.name: Apps
methods.description: Provides a list of applications.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Retrieves a handle string for an application lock.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks an application to prevent uninstallation, returns a handle.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a previously locked application via its handle.

methods.name: Reason
methods.description: Provides reason for an application lock.

methods.name: Owner
methods.description: Provides owner information for an application lock.

methods.name: GetLockInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock details for an application.
